title: On convergence rates of subgradient descent on semialgebraic functions
summary: We analyze the constant step size subgradient method on nonsmooth, nonconvex functions. We identify geometric assumptions on the objective function under which i) its domain admits a partition (stratification) into smooth manifolds (strata) on which the function is smooth; ii) a global projection formula for Clarke subgradients holds; and iii) quantitative curvature bounds hold on each stratum.
